title: Fri 23 Oct 2026: Nasdaq's worst day since June, Brent at a five-month high, Moody's on France, EBA cyber outage
summary: A tech-led sell-off on AI spending worries drags the Nasdaq down two point six percent while Treasury yields tumble and Brent hits a five-month high; Asia slides and Moody's reviews France tonight. Flash PMIs and UK retail sales land ahead of a huge week of Budget, Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan decisions. In regulation, a cyber alert takes the EBA website offline, plus transaction reporting and sustainability consultations; in funds, a two and a half billion dollar ETF seed, private credit gates and three COO action points.
